summary: Choose evidence-relevant product opportunities and feasible portfolios with prerequisite closure, remaining effort, scarce capacity, uncertainty, cheap tests, and honest roadmap commitments.
triggers: product opportunity discovery and evidence-based prioritization
compare feature portfolios with shared prerequisites and limited skills or resources
reconsider a product backlog after feedback, capacity changes, or dependency delays
plan discovery experiments and conditional Now Next Later roadmap commitments
antiTriggers: routine roadmap status update with no priority or feasibility decision
write acceptance criteria for an already selected feature
redesign a delivery process or meeting cadence without choosing product opportunities
